parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: DelayAlertPhone
parameters.description:
The mobile phone numbers that receive latency-related alerts. Separate mobile phone numbers with commas (,).

> 

*   This parameter is available only for China site (aliyun.com) users. Only mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported. Up to 10 mobile phone numbers can be specified.
*   International site (alibabacloud.com) users cannot receive alerts by using mobile phones, but can [set alert rules for DTS tasks in the Cloud Monitor console](~~175876~~).

parameters.name: DelayAlertStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to monitor task latency. Valid values:

*   **enable**: yes
*   **disable**: no

> 

*   The default value is **enable**.
*   You must specify at least one of the DelayAlertStatus and **ErrorAlertStatus** parameters.

parameters.name: DelayOverSeconds
parameters.description:
The threshold for triggering latency alerts. The unit is seconds and the value must be an integer. You can set the threshold based on your business needs. To avoid delay fluctuations caused by network and database loads, we recommend that you set the threshold to more than 10 seconds.

>  If the **DelayAlertStatus** parameter is set to **enable**, this parameter must be specified.

parameters.name: ErrorAlertPhone
parameters.description:
The mobile phone numbers that receive status-related alerts. Separate mobile phone numbers with commas (,).

> 

*   This parameter is available only for China site (aliyun.com) users. Only mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported. Up to 10 mobile phone numbers can be specified.
*   International site (alibabacloud.com) users cannot receive alerts by using mobile phones, but can [set alert rules for DTS tasks in the Cloud Monitor console](~~175876~~).

parameters.name: ErrorAlertStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to monitor task status. Valid values:

*   **enable**: yes
*   **disable**: no

> 

*   The default value is **enable**.
*   You must specify at least one of the **DelayAlertStatus** and ErrorAlertStatus parameters.
*   If the task that you monitor enters an abnormal state, an alert is triggered.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

*   **Forward**
*   **Reverse**

>  Default value: **Forward**.

parameters.name: SynchronizationJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts configure-synchronization-job-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtskxz1170c10p0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --delay-alert-status enable --delay-alert-phone 13612340000,13712340000 --error-alert-status enable --error-alert-phone 13612340000,13712340000 --delay-over-seconds 10 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
